messages:
Jules M: Morning — BetaCorp asked for per-tenant routing + sticky model pin in the MVP. They said the pilot is blocked without it.
Priya S: That was scoped for v1. Sticky routing touches routing layer, config UI, and our cache strategy.
Owen T: Rough estimate: quick sticky hack ~2w (engineering + infra), full durable sticky ~5w.
Natalie B: From PM perspective we can trade timeline or scope. Sales wants not to delay the pilot.
Jules M: Sales pushed for a compromise: 'soft-affinity' — best-effort sticky via probabilistic hashing instead of durable state.
Priya S: Probabilistic hashing = hash(tenant_id) -> variant, no persistent storage. Lower effort but not strictly sticky on failover.
Owen T: QA implications: need to track percent routed, drift rate, and a signal when affinity breaks. Console telemetry work ~4d.
Jules M: Two customer-facing options to present:
 - Option 1: Ship MVP with probabilistic affinity + explicit caveats in pilot docs (2 dev days + 2 QA days)
 - Option 2: Delay pilot by 10 business days to implement durable sticky routing (1 sprint)
Natalie B: Which impacts other launches? Delay may collide with Dedicated customer rollouts next sprint.
Priya S: If we pick Option 1, we must include acceptance criteria: documented caveats, toggle in Console to disable affinity, and a regression test in the eval suite.
Owen T: Also add rollback: a 1-click toggle to revert routing to default model, and an alert if affinity mismatch rate > 1% in 1h.
Jules M: Sales ask: will BetaCorp accept probabilistic approach if we give a 2-week trial SLA window?
Natalie B: I'll ask them and propose a pilot contract clause that calls out best-effort affinity + fallback.
Jules M: Action items:
 - Priya: confirm engineering effort and blockers by EOD (4380012600)
 - Owen: dashboard mock + acceptance criteria by EOD (4380012700)
 - Natalie: draft customer concession text and contract bullet by EOD (4380012800)
deploy-bot: Note: No releases scheduled in next 7 days.
Owen T: If customer insists on durable sticky, we escalate to roadmap reprioritization and propose a 1-sprint shift for pilot.
Jules M: I'll lead the negotiation. Plan to present Option 1 with fallback Option 2. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
